name: Phase: Implement
description: Execute an approved plan. Consumes a plan task. No re-planning.

defaults.content:
### Description

**Implementation goal:** _(restate what we're building — one sentence)_

**Approved plan:** _(set `depends_on: [<plan-task-id>]` in the frontmatter. Agent MUST read that task's plan first.)_

### Scope (STRICT)

This is an **implementation-only** task. The agent MUST:

- [ ] Read the plan task referenced in `depends_on[0]` FIRST — the plan is the source of truth
- [ ] Execute phase by phase, in order
- [ ] Run verification (tests, lint, build) at each phase boundary before moving on
- [ ] NOT re-plan or expand scope — if the plan is wrong, move task back to review with a note
- [ ] Emit an approval request (feat-task-approval-checkpoints-001, when shipped) if a genuine ambiguity arises rather than guessing

### Expected output

Code changes committed phase by phase (or one commit if the plan is small). Task comment structured as:

```markdown
## Phase 1: <name> — DONE
- Files changed: <list>
- Verification: <test/lint/build result>
- Notes: <any deviations from plan and why>

## Phase 2: <name> — DONE
...

## Deviations from plan
<anything that diverged from the plan, with reasoning>

## Follow-ups
<anything discovered during implementation that should become a separate task>
```

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Agent read the plan before writing code
- [ ] All phases completed and verified
- [ ] Tests/lint/build pass at each phase boundary
- [ ] No scope creep — deviations documented, not absorbed silently
- [ ] Follow-ups captured as notes (to become their own tasks later)
